description: This Java class defines an instrumentation test for the launch performance of the Notepad app in Android. It extends LaunchPerformanceBase and overrides lifecycle methods to initiate and measure app launch performance.

classes.name: NotePadLaunchPerformance
classes.description: An instrumentation class for measuring the launch performance of the Notepad application on Android devices.

methods.name: NotePadLaunchPerformance
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the launch performance test class.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the onCreate method to set up the intent for launching the Notepad app and start the measurement.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the onStart method to launch the app and mark the performance measurement as complete.
